prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 20s goddess, Brazilian booty glam physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped long-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with the collar and neckline slipped low off both shoulders so that her shoulders and collarbones are bare, a loose red ribbon tie hanging at her chest, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the shirt slipping off her shoulders, the loose red ribbon and the crisp tartan pleats, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme Brazilian booty glam silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.

Background: a bright observatory hall with a pale floor, a large white telescope dome behind her, a standard-height door and a short steel stair, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
